eventRows.speaker: Asura
eventRows.text: I am Asura, Seeker of Strength!

eventRows.speaker: Asura
eventRows.text: Fight me now or face obliteration!!

eventRows.note: Asura demands a fight. Roleplay, then pick.

victoryRows.speaker: Asura
victoryRows.text: Kuh....! Such splendid display of martial prowess... You are strong indeed...!

victoryRows.speaker: Asura
victoryRows.text: For one such as I, to be defeated for the third time..!
Hmph! Is that all you've got? Pathetic! And you dare call yourself a Demi-God?!
We shall spare your miserable life. Consider it an act of mercy!
But know this! From this day forth, these mountains belong to us!

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Thy master hath fallen by mine hand. Henceforth, thou shalt serve beneath me, until thy final breath.

victoryRows.speaker: Asura
victoryRows.text: You expect me to serve you...? After what you've done...?!

victoryRows.speaker: Asura
victoryRows.text: I would sooner embrace death than endure such humiliation!

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: ...Thou wouldst sooner perish than face the shame of defeat? Hmph. What utter folly.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Tell me, Demi-God. Of what worth is thy pride, should it lead thee only to the grave?

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: If thou wouldst call thyself strong, then cast aside such foolish vanity. Employ every means at thy command to vanquish thy foes.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Thou seekest vengeance upon me, dost thou not? Heh... Then by all means, cling to that hatred.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Yet look upon thyself. What hope hast thou of besting me, when thou canst scarcely stand before me?

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: If thou wouldst have thy revenge, then live. Scheme, deceive, employ whatever means thou deemest necessary. Honour and pride are but fetters worn by fools.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Until thou hast gained the strength to challenge me, thou shalt guard these mountains in my stead.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Serve me well, and thou shalt have ample time to sharpen thy claws... and perhaps, one day, turn them against me.

victoryRows.speaker: Asura
victoryRows.text: GRRR...! DAMN IT ALL! To think I'd be reminded of that day...!

victoryRows.note: Free narration: the players react to Asura. Roleplay freely, then pick how it ends.

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: Honour and pride are but fetters worn by fools... Hah! To think I would finally agree with that wretched serpent...!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: GWAHAHAHA! Very well! I concede! You have bested me this day!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: But I shall not throw away my life for the sake of wounded pride!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: Call me a coward if you must! We shall settle this another day! GWAHAHAHA!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: Honour... Pride... BAH! TO HELL WITH IT ALL!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: You dare humiliate me like this?! I WILL NOT FORGET THIS DEFEAT!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: BUT I REFUSE TO DIE HERE! MARK MY WORDS, WARRIORS!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: I SHALL RETURN, AND WHEN I DO, YOU WILL ALL TASTE MY WRATH! GRAAAHAHAHA!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: GRRR...! Enough! I've had my fill of this humiliation!

rows.speaker: Asura
rows.text: This battle is OVER! Stay out of my way!

defeatRows.note: Free narration: the party lost to Asura. Narrate what happens next, then continue.
